answer.explanation: Request rq-104, a 12-month confocal microscope service contract for $3600, was held for the grant manager and not bought. It failed the rule "Grant is active and not frozen": R01GM061721 was canceled 2026-03-10, a court restored it on 2026-04-20, but no payment has arrived since, so spending stays frozen. It also failed "Shared cost split across the grants it serves" because the service serves R01GM061721 and R21AI182745 but is charged 100% to R01GM061721, which matches the NSF OIG audit summary on shared costs charged 100% to one award. Next, the cost must be split between the two grants by use; once the split is sent, it will be checked again.
